developer_reply: Hi Jesse: Thank you for contacting us. We suggest using the 'Repeat' frequency, which is a free feature. Make sure to configure it 'Every 2 days' to make it appear every other day or 'Every 14 days' to make it appear every two weeks. Please, contact us at habitnow.apps@gmail.com if you have any questions about it!
